scope: Two selected university courses, version-pinned official implementation guides and primary papers. Original exercises, no upstream solutions.

prerequisites.en: Conventional programming and mathematics for the application algorithms; this is a parallel-computing course, not a Spark API course.
prerequisites.zh: 常规语言编程与理解应用算法所需的数学；这是并行计算课程，不是 Spark API 教程。

public_materials.en: Course outline and linked lecture PDFs are readable without an account. We checked the selected PDFs, not every archived video.
public_materials.zh: 课程主页与选用讲义 PDF 无需登录可读；核验范围为选用 PDF，不涵盖所有历史视频。

enrollment.en: Self-study of these public files needs no registration or purchase. University credit, staff support and historical machine accounts are separate; no current enrollment or fee offer is asserted.
enrollment.zh: 阅读这些公开资料无需注册或购买；学分、教学支持和历史机器账号另属正式课程，不声称当前可注册或具体收费。

era_note.en: 2016 archive. Hardware and cloud figures are historical; retain the communication, granularity and locality questions. The 2025 official page exists but says videos require a Berkeley login; it is not substituted for this open archive.
era_note.zh: 2016 年归档。硬件及云平台数字有年代性，学习通信、任务粒度和局部性问题。2025 官方页存在，但注明视频需 Berkeley 登录；不冒充全部开放的新课。

prerequisites.en: Official prerequisites: 6.1910 (6.004), plus 6.1800 (6.033) or 6.1810, or equivalent; substantial programming experience helps. Lab 1 uses Go.
prerequisites.zh: 官方先修：6.1910（6.004）以及 6.1800（6.033）或 6.1810，或同等基础；需较强编程能力，Lab 1 使用 Go。

public_materials.en: Lecture 1 notes, schedule, MapReduce paper and Lab 1 specification are public. Selected 2026 materials were available on the verification date; a tentative schedule alone is not proof of a future lecture.
public_materials.zh: Lecture 1 笔记、课表、MapReduce 原论文与 Lab 1 题面可公开访问。核验日这些 2026 资料已经发布；暂定课表不等于未来讲座已发生。

enrollment.en: Reading the public pages is free and needs no course login. MIT assessment/credit and course systems require their own enrollment; this Lab offers neither. Fees were not independently verified.
enrollment.zh: 公开页面免费阅读且无需课程登录；MIT 的评分、学分和课程系统另需正式注册，本 Lab 不提供这些服务；未独立核验学费。

era_note.en: 2026 teaching materials include the 2004 MapReduce classic. Our Spark task exception exercise is narrower than MIT's multi-process worker-crash assignment.
era_note.zh: 2026 教学资料包含 2004 年 MapReduce 经典论文。本 Lab 的 Spark 任务异常练习弱于 MIT 多进程 Worker 崩溃作业。

note.zh: 来自课程 2016-04-12 的 Lecture 23 链接；部分复用幻灯片保留 2012 日期和旧讲次编号。

note.en: Read the specification only. Do not publish a solution; the upstream collaboration policy forbids it. Our exercises do not use the assignment starter or implement its coordinator.
note.zh: 只研读题面，不公开该作业解答；原课程协作政策禁止公开解答。本 Lab 练习不使用其作业骨架，也不实现该协调器。

Resilient Distributed Datasets: A Fault-Tolerant Abstraction for In-Memory Cluster Computing

note.en: Version-pinned implementation reference, not a university course.
note.zh: 固定版本的实现参考，不算大学课程。

note.en: Read Adaptive Query Execution and Coalescing Post Shuffle Partitions. Other AQE features are untested here.
note.zh: 阅读 Adaptive Query Execution 与 Coalescing Post Shuffle Partitions；其他 AQE 功能未在本实验验证。

sources.title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models

note.en: First preprint 2019; selected v3 revised 2020. Reading extension, not an implemented training benchmark.
note.zh: 预印本始于 2019，选用 v3 于 2020 修订。只作延伸阅读，不是已实现训练基准。

note.en: Published OSDI 2022. Read iteration-level scheduling for variable-length requests; no inference engine runs in this Lab.
note.zh: 已发表于 OSDI 2022；学习变长请求的迭代级调度。本 Lab 未运行推理引擎。

readings.locator: Lecture 1 (19 Jan 2016): motivation and parallel performance
Lecture 3 (26 Jan 2016): machine and programming models

exercise.authorship: original Lab exercise; not an upstream assignment solution

predict.en: With two slots, predict whether 64 tiny tasks beat eight. Explain why task count does not mean 64 cores.
predict.zh: 只有两个槽位时，预测 64 个小任务是否胜过 8 个，解释任务数为何不等于核数。

acceptance.en: Every result equals independent sum 119516556; inspect 1/8/64 TaskEnd attempts and all timings.
acceptance.zh: 各方案均等于独立和 119516556；检查 1/8/64 个 TaskEnd 尝试与全部耗时。

boundary.en: local[2,2], one JVM; neither the cost widget nor the run proves machine scaling.
boundary.zh: local[2,2] 单 JVM；成本控件与此运行都不能证明多机扩展。

title.zh: 从 MapReduce 到 DAG 与 Stage

readings.locator: CASE STUDY: MapReduce; The shuffle; Coordinator
PDF pages 30–47: MapReduce, recovery and Spark concepts

exercise.authorship: original Lab exercise; not an upstream assignment solution

predict.en: Draw map-side work, exchange and reduce-side work before running. Which dependency causes a stage boundary?
predict.zh: 执行前画 map 侧、交换与 reduce 侧；哪个依赖形成 Stage 边界？

acceptance.en: Find ShuffledRDD in both saved lineages and two task stages in each measured group; output still matches all key totals.
acceptance.zh: 在保存的两份 Lineage 中找到 ShuffledRDD，并在每个计时组中找到两个任务阶段；所有键的结果仍正确。

boundary.en: This RDD trace illustrates the model; it does not implement MIT Lab 1 or its RPC coordinator.
boundary.zh: 此 RDD 轨迹解释模型，并未实现 MIT Lab 1 或 RPC 协调器。

readings.locator: Working with Key-Value Pairs; reduceByKey versus groupByKey

exercise.authorship: original Lab exercise; not an upstream assignment solution

predict.en: Explain why summing locally preserves a monoid; why averaging local means without counts fails.
predict.zh: 解释局部求和为何可合并；为什么不带数量的局部平均数不能直接平均。

acceptance.en: Compare the full 1,000-key oracle and Shuffle bytes; distinguish serialized batches from source records.
acceptance.zh: 核对完整 1,000 键 oracle 与 Shuffle 字节；区分序列化批次与源记录。

boundary.en: Local Shuffle bytes measure engine serialization, not cross-host network traffic.
boundary.zh: 本机 Shuffle 字节是引擎序列化指标，不是跨机网络流量。

title.en: Skew, replication and the long tail

readings.locator: Lecture 23 (12 Apr 2016): task granularity and dynamic load balancing
Join Strategy Hints; broadcast and merge hints

exercise.authorship: original Lab exercise; not an upstream assignment solution

predict.en: Predict the hottest output partition under 80% hot-key skew; what extra work does salting add?
predict.zh: 80% 热键下预测最热输出分区；加盐额外增加了什么工作？

acceptance.en: All variants: 240000 rows, weighted sum 384001; compare partition histograms and SortMergeJoin/BroadcastHashJoin plans. Keep the slower salted observation.
acceptance.zh: 各方案均为 240000 行、加权和 384001；比较分区直方图与 Join 计划，保留加盐更慢的观测。

boundary.en: Unique dimension keys. The old join plans are pre-action strategy evidence, not final AQE plans; AQE skew join remains untested.
boundary.zh: 维表键唯一。旧 Join 计划为执行前策略证据，不是最终 AQE 计划；AQE skew join 仍未实测。

readings.locator: Introduction; Your Job; worker timeout and crash tests (study only)
Sections 2.1 and 5: abstraction and implementation, recovery/checkpointing

exercise.authorship: original Lab exercise; not an upstream assignment solution

predict.en: Which result survives one task exception? What changes when a cache block is removed?
predict.zh: 一次任务异常后哪些结果应保持？移除缓存后什么会改变？

acceptance.en: One failed then successful partition-0 attempt; evaluations 8/0/8; ReliableCheckpointRDD truncates lineage.
acceptance.zh: 分区 0 先失败后成功；求值次数 8/0/8；ReliableCheckpointRDD 截断 Lineage。

boundary.en: No killed executor or host. Local checkpoint cannot survive host loss; this is weaker than MIT worker-crash testing.
boundary.zh: 没有杀 Executor 或主机；本地检查点不抵抗整机丢失，弱于 MIT Worker 崩溃测试。

readings.locator: Lecture 2 (21 Jan 2016): locality and memory hierarchy

exercise.authorship: original Lab exercise; not an upstream assignment solution

predict.en: Will more partitions change the working set even with unchanged slots? Distinguish CPU caches from persisted RDD storage.
predict.zh: 槽位不变时更多分区是否改变工作集？区分 CPU Cache 与 RDD 持久化存储。

acceptance.en: Validate sorted payloads, row count and ID sum; inspect nonzero real Spill and per-task memory counters.
acceptance.zh: 验证已消费且局部有序的 payload、行数与 ID 和；检查真实非零 Spill 与逐任务内存指标。

boundary.en: Spill is forced by 8192 elements, not natural OOM; task peak execution memory is not process RSS.
boundary.zh: Spill 由 8192 元素阈值强制触发，不是自然 OOM；任务执行内存峰值不是进程 RSS。

readings.locator: Adaptive Query Execution → Coalescing Post Shuffle Partitions
Dynamic scheduling and task-size overhead as conceptual background

exercise.authorship: original Lab exercise; not an upstream assignment solution

predict.en: Predict why merely enabling AQE may leave 32 reducers, and whether 1-byte versus 1-MiB targets produce the same final plan.
predict.zh: 预测仅开启 AQE 为何可能仍有 32 个 reducer，以及 1 字节与 1 MiB 目标是否形成同一最终计划。

acceptance.en: Full per-key count/sum oracle; compare pre/final plans, AQEShuffleRead SQL metrics and actual TaskEnd stages. Run the 1-byte counterexample in the walkthrough.
acceptance.zh: 完整逐键 count/sum oracle；比较执行前/最终计划、AQEShuffleRead SQL 指标与实际 TaskEnd 阶段；按指南运行 1 字节反例。

boundary.en: Only post-shuffle coalescing is implemented. Join adaptation, distributed training and inference remain reading extensions.
boundary.zh: 只实现 Shuffle 后分区合并；Join 自适应、分布式训练与推理仅为阅读延伸。
